scope: Only the five candidate file snapshots identified by SHA-256, their called repository methods and the existing database/update-handoff contracts. Working tree is uncommitted.

evidence.owner: registrationItem calls require before looking up the exact durable identity; registrationStage requires owner in the same write transaction. Fallback add rechecks owner, enforces unique identity and ignores conflicts.
evidence.atomicStateAndAppend: registrationStage calculates existence-based precedence and updates state/error/event inside one SQLite write transaction; actual batch append writes selected items, consent and report RUNNING/total in its own same write transaction, preserving state in either transaction order.
evidence.legacyAndPrecedence: State precedence matches prior full counts: RUNNING or QUEUED; WAITING_REMOTE; NEEDS_ACTION to PARTIAL; CANCELLED; otherwise SUCCEEDED. Existing item IDs and contents are reused. A legacy report with an already-wrong total is not re-counted on existing-item begin as it was before; no evidence reviewed establishes such stale historical data.
evidence.keepaliveAndHandoff: Each card session opens before reporting and closes after its try/catch, before the next send-loop UpdateHandoff checkpoint; connection is separate and autocommit, no write transaction is held for remote HTTP. Existing second readback loop has no per-item UpdateHandoff checkpoint; unchanged.
evidence.testCoverage: Scale test contains 3000/10000 synthetic items with SQLite VM instruction budget and old full aggregate negative control; it checks owner denial, state precedence, appended item and reopen. Lifetime test checks synthetic first-card pause, receipt and GTIN persistence, independent writer, and exclusive journal-mode change after idle. Tests do not measure real Catalog, live licenses, real signatures, installer, or 300-card Windows duration.
evidence.execution: No tests, builds, network calls, writes to production systems or installer actions performed as part of this review. Concurrent Maven run belongs to the coordinating agent and is not represented as passed here.

limits: No newly executed tests claimed by this review.
First Windows 300-card run documented separately as failed; this review does not replace a fresh Windows regression or production acceptance.
Appended-item/finish serialization was reasoned from transactions; the scale test exercises append and state transitions sequentially, not a forced simultaneous interleaving.
Pre-existing readback loop does not checkpoint between items, so an updater can wait for a complete readback pass.
No fixture with a historically inconsistent sync_runs.total was examined.
